title: Best Robotic Arm (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Reviewed the provided sources and selected products mentioned by more than one source.
assumptions: No price information was available in the sources.

verdict.line: Picture a busy household where a robotic arm can pick up toys and small items. The Saros Z70 can pick up and sort objects with its OmniGrip arm, and it also vacuums and mops. The catch: it has navigation and software bugs.
